title: The Best-Rate Guarantee on a Hotel Rate Plans Reservation
content:
Where the identical room at the identical property on the identical dates is publicly offered for less within the claim window of the Hotel Rate Plans plan booked, the difference is settled to the card together with the plan's goodwill amount.

**One settlement per reservation.** A best-rate settlement is raised only when no best-rate settlement has already been raised against the same reservation. The folio lines standing on that reservation are what show whether one has been raised.

**Where the window is measured from.** The window is measured from the moment the reservation was booked.

**What counts as a comparison.** The comparison is made against a publicly bookable rate in the same currency with the same board basis and the same cancellation terms.

**A plan without the guarantee.** A plan that does not carry the guarantee refuses the claim outright, and no credit is offered in its place.

**What the settlement is raised against.** The settlement is raised against the original room line and never against taxes, the facility fee or the agency service fee.

**After the dates have moved.** A claim raised after the guest has moved the dates is refused, because the reservation compared is no longer the reservation booked.

## Whether a claim stands

| Test | The claim stands only if |
| --- | --- |
| The plan | the rate plan booked carries the guarantee |
| The window | the lower rate is found within the plan's claim window, measured from the moment of booking |
| The comparison | the offer is publicly bookable, in the same currency, on the same board basis and on the same cancellation terms, for the identical room at the identical property on the identical dates |
| Prior settlement | no best-rate settlement has already been raised against this reservation |
| The dates | the guest has not moved the dates |

## Worked illustration on hypothetical figures

A hypothetical room booked at 260.00 USD and found publicly at 215.00 USD inside the window, on a plan whose goodwill amount is 25.0 USD: the difference of 45.00 USD and the goodwill amount of 25.00 USD come to 70.00 USD settled to the card, raised against the original room line and not against the taxes or the facility fee standing beside it.
